eyebrow: scipy.optimize: the shape of the API
code:
result = optimize.minimize(
    lambda x: (x[0]-3)**2 + (x[1]+1)**2,
    x0=[0, 0])
result.x       # [3. -1.]
result.success # always check this
caption: Lessons 9-10 go deep; always confirm .success before trusting .x.

code:
from scipy.signal import savgol_filter
smoothed = savgol_filter(
    prices, window_length=21,
    polyorder=2)
# preserves trend shape better

caption: Built for signal processing, useful on noisy financial series too.
